title: Encrypted Fuzzy Delphi: expert consensus on homomorphically encrypted ballots
description: Proof of concept running the fuzzy Delphi expert-consensus method on homomorphically encrypted ballots (OpenFHE, BFV). Experts encrypt one-hot linguistic ratings on their own device; the server validates ballots, maps them to triangular fuzzy numbers, and computes fuzzy means, centroid defuzzification and consensus distances entirely on ciphertexts. Results are revealed only via 3-of-3 threshold decryption. Malformed ballots are detected without revealing their content. Final version: 385 KB per expert, exact results. Simulated data; semi-honest server model; not independently reviewed. Includes negative results from earlier fuzzy-logic/FHE credit-scoring experiments.
notes: Code written with the assistance of an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic).
